text:
2025/0258(COD) | Euro Counterfeiting Protection Programme
Rapporteur: Michael Mcnamara (Renew) | Lead committee: LIBE

📅 28 September 2026 | 🗳️ Lead committee adopted its report
What's next: A negotiating mandate for talks with the Council would usually follow, or the report goes straight to a plenary vote. No deadline applies.

Summary: The proposal aims to fund a programme that would provide training and support to law enforcement and other officials across participating countries to help them detect and prevent counterfeit euro banknotes and coins. It seeks to strengthen cooperation and share expertise on protecting the currency from counterfeiting threats.
